{{Top|leg}}
A '''pocket colony''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gand (planet)/Legends|Gand]]. These colonies were isolated by [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of thick [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] mists and were ruled by Gand's totalitarian monarchy. A [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Gand nest|nest]] often contained individuals who hailed from the same colony.
